source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original patch snapshots the current window screen availability after content prefill and reuses it in snapToCorner. Outer dimensions remain live. This prevents later snap calls from rereading another screen value, but it does not explicitly choose the primary monitor. Accepted code later queries the primary screen in device coordinates and converts by the current devicePixelRatio, with a window-screen fallback. Keep those later DPI/monitor-selection changes separate. Historical reporter success is configuration-specific; no placement or accessibility run was performed.
title: The first alert-position cache captures the window screen rather than querying the primary screen
